description: We are going for innovative approach and trying something different.
summary: Landing on the Moon's South Pole is challenging due to its extreme environment, uneven terrain, permanently shadowed regions, limited sunlight and communication obstacles. Scientists must carefully evaluate multiple factors before selecting a safe and suitable landing location. However, analysing terrain conditions, sunlight availability, temperature and Earth visibility using different scientific datasets can be complex and time-consuming. Moonscape aims to solve this problem by combining NASA lunar datasets, scientific calculations, interactive 3D visualization and AI-assisted analysis to help identify, evaluate and compare potentially suitable lunar landing sites, particularly around the Shackleton Crater region.
